bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
echo "INLINE_MODE_RECHECK"
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("/run/secrets/bot_token","utf8").trim();const c=new AbortController();setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),15000);fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+t+"/getMe",{signal:c.signal}).then(r=>r.json()).then(x=>{if(!x.ok||!x.result){console.log("BOT_GETME_FAILED");process.exitCode=2}else{console.log("BOT_ID="+x.result.id);console.log("INLINE_SUPPORT="+(x.result.supports_inline_queries===true?"ENABLED":"DISABLED"));if(x.result.supports_inline_queries!==true)process.exitCode=3}}).catch(()=>{console.log("BOT_GETME_NETWORK_FAIL");process.exitCode=2})'
echo "DB_LINK_SCHEMA"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='link_button_posts' ORDER BY ordinal_position" 2>/dev/null || echo DB_QUERY_FAILED
echo "LIVE_IMAGE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
echo "LIVE_ROOT_HEAD=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "INLINE_MODE_RECHECK_END"
